Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning preferential hiring of veterans by the marine division of the department of transportation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the preferential hiring of veterans by themarine division of the department of transportation; and adding a newsection to chapter 47.60 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) To the greatest extent practicable and within availableresources, the marine division of the department shall expand existingopportunities and develop new opportunities to provide for thepreferential hiring of veterans. Options may include, but are notlimited to, increasing awareness of the veteran preference pointshiring process, notifying veteran assistance organizations of relevantjob vacancies, collaborating with other applicable state and localagencies to increase veteran hiring, and participating in the woundedcombat veterans internship program. For the purposes of this section,"veteran" has the same meaning as in RCW 41.04.007. (2) The department may adopt rules as necessary to implement the p. 1 SSB 6457requirements of this section.
